description: This script automates building and running a Docker container to perform end-to-end testing for the openclaw project, including setting up mock systemctl and loginctl commands, packaging and installing npm modules, and verifying service entry points.

methods.name: assert_entrypoint
methods.description: Verifies that the systemd service unit has the expected ExecStart entrypoint.

methods.name: run_flow
methods.description: Executes a test flow consisting of installing a service and verifying its entry point before and after running the doctor command.
